chance.description: Percentage chance to progress to this condition
chance.title: Chance

when.description: The state the condition must be in to allow this progression to occur.
when.title: When

allow_scar.description: If progressing to this condition should be allowed the chance to scar.
allow_scar.title: Allow Scar

severity.description: Severity of the condition. For permanent conditions, major and severe conditions can cause the cat to retire early. For temporary conditions, major and minors conditions will prevent the cat from working.
severity.title: Severity

mortality.description: Percent chance for this condition to kill the cat. Can be left empty if the condition is not fatal.
mortality.title: Mortality

immune_system_effect.description: Effect on the percent chance that this cat will be infected by a different condition. This float will be added to the percent chance, thus increasing the cat's likely-hood to contract an infectious condition.
immune_system_effect.title: Immune System Effect

progression.description: The conditions that this condition can progress into (i.e. be replaced by). Can be left empty if the condition has no progressions.
progression.title: Progression

risks.description: Extra conditions that can be gained while the cat has this condition. Float is the percentage chance to apply this condition.
risks.title: Risks

treatment_strength.description: Lists of herbs that can be used for treatment of this condition. The 1, 2, 3 keys correspond to the strength of the herbs. Can be left empty if no herbs can be used to treat this condition.
treatment_strength.title: Treatment Strength

possible_scars.description: List of scars this condition can give upon healing.
possible_scars.title: Possible Scars

duration.description: How many moons the cat will have this condition.
duration.title: Duration

infectiousness.description: Percentage chance that the cat will infect others with this condition. Can be set to 0.0 if the condition cannot infect others.
infectiousness.title: Infectiousness

side_effect.description: Extra conditions that can also be applied as a 'bonus' when this condition is given to the cat. Float is the percentage chance that the condition will be applied.
side_effect.title: Side Effect

is_complication.description: If condition is a complication of another condition (i.e. infection is a complication) and cannot be given on it's own.
is_complication.title: Is Complication

description: Temporary condition info in Clan Generator.
title: TemporaryConditionInfoSchema
